name: Smooth Talk
description: Become an expert on subtle lies and mental manipulation. As a Major Action, take a Stress to make a creature believe a minor detail you say, such as having just arrived in the area, or working at a local tavern, or shift the suspicion from yourself to a nearby individual. If your lie is very weak or a target is particularly insightful, they may make a Reflex saving throw at the DM's discretion.
